verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official CLI and workspace REST APIs for terminal and automation use, and states that Unity Catalog objects can be worked with through SQL, the CLI and REST APIs, which covers headless schema discovery. Unity Catalog enforces access control and audit logging on every query, and agents can authenticate to managed MCP servers whose tools include querying tables. Databricks Connect and the Python SDK give further programmatic paths without a dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit doc that SQL statements can be executed and results paged back via API or CLI (the cited SQL API covers query objects), a documented CLI/API authentication flow, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full loop.
